text:
Maya (CS): quick sync after three onboarding check-ins today. common asks: better onboarding checklist in Console, a one-click export of customer feature asks, and a visibility metric for 'time-to-first-success' per account.
Ethan (SE): adding that we saw a customer (Nimbus Inc) misunderstand routing defaults and got unexpected token usage. they'd like a friendly in-Console banner during first 7 days.
Lina (PM): high-level thoughts: short-term -> export + banner; medium -> checklist UX; long -> account-level TTF success metric. we should score asks by renewal exposure.
Maya (CS): proposed capture format in ticket: 1) short description, 2) example quote, 3) account tier, 4) renewal window, 5) rough impact estimate. i'll standardize and batch.
Sam (Enablement): for the banner we can repurpose the onboarding tips copy from the playbook. i'll prepare messaging to A/B test.
Ethan (SE): effort estimates: export CSV of feature asks (backend + CSV job + UI link) ~2 dev days; banner + tracking ~3 days (frontend + experiment flag); onboarding checklist redesign ~1 sprint.
ops-bot: created CS-TKT-8812 "Feature-asks export + ingest", linked CS-TKT-8813 "First-week cost banner".
Maya (CS): verbatim from customer: "We lost a week trying to figure out why our agent kept hitting budget. A simple 'this route is in test mode' banner would have saved us."
Lina (PM): I'll add both tickets to the triage board and apply this scoring rubric: urgency = (renewal_window_weeks <=4 ? 5 : 2) + (tier == "Enterprise" ? 3 : 1) + (ops_exposure ? 2 : 0). anything >=8 = high.
Ethan (SE): can we also add a telemetry flag `onboarding.first_week.banner_shown` so CS can report who saw it?
Sam (Enablement): agree, also want a link to a short how-to video in the banner (15s). i'll draft.
Maya (CS): i'll batch up 12 raw asks with quotes, account tiers, and renewal dates by EOD for scoring. ping me if you want customer IDs.
Lina (PM): thanks all. plan: ship export + banner as quick wins in next sprint, checklist redesign in the following. will call out high-scoring items for potential renewal outreach. :calendar:
Ethan (SE): noted. i'll scope tickets and reply with exact estimates by tomorrow morning.
Maya (CS): thanks team, will follow up with the scored bundle and outreach plan.
